view: Frontal (PA) erect chest radiograph; L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate: full inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation, adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac shadow), whole thorax including both costophrenic angles included; left scapula partly projects over the left upper lateral lung field

devices.type: Implanted venous access port (port-a-cath reservoir, round metallic ring with suture holes) with attached catheter coursing medially and superiorly; catheter tip not confidently traceable on this film
devices.location: Left lower anterior chest wall, projected over the left lower zone at the left cardiophrenic region, just above the left hemidiaphragm
Image upper right corner (patient's left shoulder region)

abnormalities.finding: Diffuse coarse reticular / reticulonodular interstitial opacities with peribronchial thickening and ring shadows (bronchiectasis-type pattern), most conspicuous in the perihilar and upper-middle zones; lung volumes preserved to mildly increased
Prominent, somewhat nodular bilateral hila (hilar enlargement - vascular vs adenopathy)
Mild elevation of the right hemidiaphragm relative to the left (about 2-2.5 cm, borderline)
Implanted venous port device projected over the left lower zone / cardiophrenic region (device, low chest-wall placement)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA，右上方可見L標記），吸氣量足夠、無明顯旋轉，穿透度適當。左下前胸壁可見一植入式靜脈注射座（port-a-cath），投影於左側心橫膈角區域、左橫膈上方，導管向內上方走行，尖端於本片無法明確追蹤。雙側肺野呈瀰漫性粗糙網狀／網狀結節狀間質增加，伴支氣管壁增厚及環狀影，以肺門周圍與上中肺野較明顯，符合支氣管擴張／慢性間質性肺病變之表現；雙側肺門增大且輪廓略呈結節狀。心臟大小正常、縱膈居中，雙側肋膈角清晰、無肋膜積液或氣胸，右側橫膈較左側輕度抬高，骨骼與軟組織無明顯異常。
